items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: He was my roommate in theaters. Gladys would assign he and I to dressing rooms together wherever we go.

ctx.x: He talked to her confidentially. And this is what they was telling him. She said, you better not say I said anything. She said, what they done, they tell you that you're booked up for a year, but Johnny Boswell is available, and Herbie ain't got a job. He says, that's what they're doing. They're calling in for Herbie Fields, and they said Johnny Boswell said, he's booked up for a year. Can't get him now. I'm telling you how they do.

So Herbie didn't say anything. He went to Joe Glazer and told Joe Glazer about it and said what was happening to him. And he said, don't worry about it. I'll break that contract, said, contract ain't worth the paper it's written on at Joe Glazer's. He got Herbie out of there and signed him up on a contract. He said, but I'm going to have to bill you.
